# AvatarGroup

A row of avatars that overlap, with the rest behind a `+n`. The group owns what one avatar cannot: the overlap, the ring that separates neighbors, and how many fit. Past `max`, the remaining people go into a menu under `+n`, the same overflow the tag group uses, so every person stays reachable by name.

**Import:** `import { AvatarGroup } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/images-and-icons/AvatarGroup/AvatarGroup.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/images-and-icons/AvatarGroup/AvatarGroup.stories.jsx` — Group, GroupFits, Sizes, GroupSizeAndShape, Interactive, Rest, Hovered, Pressed, Focused, Disabled

## Usage

Use `AvatarGroup` for a short set of people that would crowd a line: the
attendees of a session, the members of a team. Past `max`, the rest fold into
a `+n` menu, reachable by name.

Use plain `Avatar` elements, not `AvatarGroup`, where there is room to name
each person beside their picture.

## Best practices

### Let the group set the size and shape. {#let-the-group-set-the-size-and-shape}

`AvatarGroup` passes its `size` and `shape` to every `Avatar` child, so the
row stays even even when a child sets its own.

Do: The group sets one size and shape for every child.
Don't: Children that set their own size and shape, which the group ignores.

### `max` counts the `+n` in. {#max-counts-the-n-in}

Five people with `max={5}` show all five; a sixth pushes one into `+2` —
`max` is the most avatars the row ever shows, the `+n` included.

Do: Three people fit in max 3, with no +n.
Don't: A fourth person shows two avatars and +2, because the +n takes a slot.

### Keep the group short. {#keep-the-group-short}

Use it for a handful of people. For a roster, link to the list instead of folding sixty names behind `+n`.

Do: A handful, with the rest behind the +n.
Don't: Folding most of a roster behind +n: link to the list instead.

## Accessibility

- **Name the group.** `label` names the group for assistive technology —
  "Session attendees" — the same way `Avatar`'s `label` names a person.
- **The `+n` is a named button.** It reads "+3, 3 more people", opens a menu
  of the hidden people by name, reached with Tab and closed with Escape.
- **Every shown avatar keeps its own name.** The group changes `size` and
  `shape`, never an avatar's accessible name.

## Related

- For a single person or agent, use `Avatar`.
- For the signed-in person, with a name and a role, use the Sidebar's account row.

Same group: `AiIcon` · `Avatar` · `Icon` · `Illustration` · `Image` · `Object` · `Tile`

## Parts

1. **Avatars.** Up to `max`; when people overflow, `max` minus one plus the `+n`. Each the group's size and shape, overlapping by a quarter.
2. **Ring.** A surface-colored ring around each avatar that separates neighbors.
3. **Overflow.** A gray `+n` button that opens a menu of the people left out, by name.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | Overlapping avatars; the `+n` in `--ds-background-accent-gray-subtler`. |
| Hovered | The `+n` takes `--ds-background-accent-gray-subtle`. The avatars do not change. |
| Pressed | Opens the menu and sets `aria-expanded`. Escape closes it. |
| Focused | A 2px ring in `--ds-border-focused` on the `+n`, for keyboard focus only. |
| Disabled | None. With nothing to fold there is no `+n`, only pictures. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Avatar size | `--image-xxs` to `--image-lg`, from the group's `size`. |
| Overlap | A quarter of the avatar size. |
| Overflow fill | `--ds-background-accent-gray-subtler`; hovered `--ds-background-accent-gray-subtle`. |
| Focus ring | `--ds-border-focused`. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Name the group for what it holds: "Session attendees". | "Avatars" or "People", which names the picture, not the set. |
| Let `+n` count only the people left out. | Write your own count in the label; it will drift from the menu. |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `children` | node | — | `Avatar` elements. |
| `max` | number | `5` | The most avatars on the row, counting the `+n`. Default 5. |
| `size` | oneOf | `32` | One size for the whole row; it overrides each avatar's own. |
| `shape` | oneOf | `'circle'` | One shape for the whole row. |
| `label` | string | — | Names the group for assistive technology: "Session attendees". |
| `overflowLabel` | func | — | Formats the overflow's visible text. Defaults to `+n`. |
| `className` | string | `''` | Extra class names added to the group element beside the component's own. |
